node.label: Unesterified cholesterol accumulation in cultured fibroblasts
node.definition: An abnormal result of the filipin test. This test is based on the reaction of unesterified cholesterol with fluorescent antibiotic filipin giving a strongly fluorescent, stable cholesterol-filipin complex suitable for in situ detection. An abnormal test result is present if there is a perinuclear accumulation of staining in lysosomal storage organelles (LSOs).
